tool_input.description: Run in-file tests and benchmark headless via Node
Run game tests and benchmark headlessly in Node

claude.result:
Sandboxed Node execution wasn't permitted, so I verified the file by careful review rather than by running it. The game is complete at `game.html`.

**What was built** — ASHFALL OUTPOST, a single self-contained HTML file (~700 lines, no external resources, no browser storage) implementing all 13 requested systems:

- **Core loop**: single state object, mulberry32 PRNG seeded 1337 (editable in the header), no `Math.random` anywhere; the nine-phase turn order is documented in the header comment and mirrored exactly in `endTurn()`.
- **Map**: 8×8 seeded terrain (ash/rock/water/vent/ruins), click-to-build with terrain requirements, and adjacency bonuses (condenser + water, forge/generator + vent) shown in tooltips and the build menu.
- **Economy**: real chains — mine→ore, ore+power→metal (forge), water→soil→food (greenhouse), metal+power→parts (workshop) — with per-resource storage caps and logged overflow loss.
- **Population & needs**: named colonists with job/skill/fatigue/morale, one-worker-per-building assignment, skill growth with use, shortage penalties that degrade before anyone leaves (refuse work below 25 morale, depart at 0).
- **Research**: 10 nodes with prerequisites, scrip/parts costs, and locked/available/done badges; unlocks buildings and yield/storm/trade modifiers.
- **Events**: 12-event weighted deck with cooldowns; 4 present a 2–3 option modal with real tradeoffs, all mutating state.
- **Trade**: caravan every 8 turns with limited stock/demand; prices react to your stockpile plus a drifting global multiplier.
- **Storms**: every 7 turns, severity scaling with turn count, building damage (zero output until a 2-part repair), doubled water draw, mitigated by walls, forecasting research, and the scrubber.
- **Save/load**: JSON textarea on the Dev tab with validation and clear errors; win/lose/score summary screen; tabbed UI with Space/1–6 keys, tooltips on every number, and a layout that works at 360px.
- **Dev panel**: "Run Tests" (18 invariant assertions — negatives, caps, prereqs, terrain rules, determinism, save/load hash round-trip, cooldowns, losability) and "Run Benchmark" (200-turn headless greedy sim printing an FNV-1a state hash that is identical across runs of the same seed).

One caveat: I attempted to execute the test suite headlessly via Node but the command required approval I don't have in this session, so runtime verification is pending — opening the file and clicking "Run Tests" on the Dev tab will confirm the assertions.
